title: Someone came this far before you
description: Four of them, by the mail. Nobody came back to bury them.

choices.text: Take what they no longer need.

onPass.narration: A purse under the mail, dry as the day it was tied. They would have done the same.

onFail.narration: The strap rots through in your hand and the pack goes over the edge into the dark.

choices.text: Say the words over them first.

onPass.narration: Somebody remembers enough of the words to finish them. The company walks on steadier than it stopped.

onFail.narration: Half the words, then nothing. The silence afterwards is worse than none at all.

onPass.narration: Nobody looks twice, and everybody looks once.
